thread:
Maya CS: Quick flag — Satori onboarding batch enroll p95 jumped from ~95ms to ~220ms in last 24h. Renewal meeting tomorrow; low usage trend. Proposing a short proactive perf pilot: int8 quant + 10% traffic to a dedicated pool, auto-fallback to fp16. Need approvals and a one-line customer consent.

Adarsh RM: Any eval regressions on their prompt subset?

Maya CS: Small — ~0.7% detokenize diffs on fringe prompts only. Not in main flows. Canary with fallback should be safe.

Jin Eng: I can build the quant artifact (int8-pilot-a) and wire a 10% traffic-split rollout with fallback and monitors. What's the success criteria?

Maya CS: Criteria: QoE delta <1% on their eval set AND p95 <120ms during 6h canary -> ramp to 100% within 24h.

Lucas SRE: I can reserve a tiny dedicated pool in us-west-2 02:00–04:00 UTC for the window and add deeper tracing. Alerts: token-loss >0.5% or p95 reg >20% => rollback.

Eve PM: Product asks for a one-pager for Satori (benefit, rollback, opt-out) and a 1-question in-app feedback nudge post-canary. Keep messaging simple.

Maya CS: Proposed customer consent text: 'We will run a short performance canary (10% of requests) with automatic rollback if quality impact is detected.' I'll log their reply.

Adarsh RM: I'll attach a renewal note highlighting the perf uplift and mitigation checklist for procurement.

Jin Eng: I'll schedule the canary job and post logs to #eng-runtime. Aim for >=500 requests per variant for basic confidence.

redwood-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-3610 at 2026-04-12T02:00Z by Jin Eng

Maya CS: Approvals?

Lucas SRE: Approved.

Adarsh RM: Approved.

Jin Eng: Approved.

Eve PM: Approved. Proceeding with artifact build and customer outreach.
